## Summary

Describe the change and why it is needed.

## Validation

- [ ] npm test passes
- [ ] JavaScript syntax checks pass when applicable
- [ ] Manual Chrome or fixture-lab testing completed, or the reason it was skipped is documented

## Security and privacy

- [ ] No passwords, cookies, tokens, or form values are stored
- [ ] New page-derived input is validated and bounded
- [ ] Permissions and baseline behavior were reviewed

## Release impact

- [ ] Versioning or README updates are included if needed
- [ ] Migration or compatibility notes are documented
- [ ] Screenshots or evidence are attached for UI changes

## Notes for reviewers

Add anything reviewers should know, including known limitations or follow-up work.
